verdict.rationale: A state commercial registry could plausibly publish bulk datasets or registry extracts, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only per-record online services: name searches, standing certificates, document copies, UCC status reports and active-notary lookups. Nothing describes a bulk download, dataset or extract file that would spare a developer from scraping.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
